fields.statement: Re-ran in a detached worktree at 9b60faa with RHIZA_* unset. review-findings.txtar passes: in a review run with checks alpha, beta, gamma, alpha records finding f1 (major, main.go:12) and a confirmed verdict on it, beta records two findings (one nit, one minor about leaf second), gamma an empty round; grep on the run journal finds the findings and verdict entries tagged check alpha/beta and cycle 1, `run status` text shows each check's round 1 with findings and verdicts, and `run status --json` shows three rounds arrays with check, severity, place, reason, leaf/leaf_handle and verdict fields. Refusals each exit 2 with the journal line count unchanged (check.log compared): severity critical, unknown check delta, missing --check, leaf outsider not in the change set, empty place, empty reason, plan kind field, and verdicts naming f9 (alpha round 1) and f3 (beta round 1). TestFoldCheckRounds passes (per-check rounds, cycle tagging, plan rounds untouched). Plan-review and review scripts pass: plan-workflow, plan-workflow-autonomous, plan-workflow-autonomous-left, run-review-check, run-review-check-landed, run-review-journal, autonomous-review, review-checks-step, build-verifier-findings, guide, run-arbitrate-asked, run-gate. describe-golden passes without -update and the commit regenerates it. go test ./... -count=1 passes in every package.
